title: Cylindrical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates (0.009, 0.009) with a radius of 0.009. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0067. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch using a scaling factor of 0.0181 to achieve the desired dimensions. Transform this scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by applying the previously defined Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical rod with a conical tip and a cylindrical tip are 0.018075 units in length, 0.018075 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.009, 0.009)

# Create the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.009)

# Create the inner circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0067)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical rod
extrusion_depth = 0.75
cylinder = sketch.extrude(extrusion_depth)

# Create the conical tip
cone_radius = 0.009
cone_height = 0.018074999999999997
cone = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.009, 0.009).circle(cone_radius).extrude(cone_height, taper=1.0)

# Create the cylindrical tip
cylinder_tip_radius = 0.0067
cylinder_tip_height = 0.018074999999999997
cylinder_tip = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.009, 0.009).circle(cylinder_tip_radius).extrude(cylinder_tip_height)

# Combine the parts
r = cylinder.union(cone).union(cylinder_tip)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.009, 0.009)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.009)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.006)         # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
